note: Java bridge round 45 fixes: a set vespera.bridge.include-patterns with no non-blank entry (for example an unset ${VAR:} placeholder) now fails startup instead of widening the proxy to /**; an unset list keeps the default. The Gradle plugin fails the build when vespera.targets is set without cargoRoot or targetDir instead of silently dropping the cross-built libraries. OpenAPI merge renames security requirements inside components.pathItems and components.callbacks too. A form body a WebFilter drained without caching its form data answers 500 (server-side consumption) instead of 400. UnknownAppException messages carry the bounded loggable app name. Documentation: the X-Forwarded-* trust model in the bridge README and HeaderPolicy javadoc. Test-only: direct buffer growth steps, a GET with an empty Rust body keeps Content-Length 0.
